text: Nervous before a date? Thinking, what if she doesn't like me? What if it gets boring? What if the kiss doesn't work? Relax, you are overcomplicating it. Here's the truth. If she shows up to the date, you are already in a good position. She had other guys texting her other things she could be doing, but she chose to spend her evening with you. That means she is interested. So don't treat that date like an exam you have to pass. The number one goal is simple. Have a good time. Bring good energy, relax, enjoy yourself. When you are having fun, she feels it too. Number two, see it as an experience. Every date teaches you something. How to talk, how to find topics, how to handle pauses. Even if it doesn't go anywhere, you still walk away more confident than before. And only third comes the result. If it leads to another date, kisses, or more, great. If not, that's fine too. You move on. Of course, having fun doesn't mean acting careless. You should still act right, flirt, and keep it effective. But with this mindset, fun first, experience second, result third, you'll always show up confident, relaxed, and way more attractive.
